translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Nǝb̃ol p̃usan husur nǝhanan hǝn nǝlahan
AYesu ib̃ol p̃usan tǝtas mai galit am, ike,
“Natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav imaiegai. Ikad nakiŋ sua toutaut hǝn nǝhanan hǝn nǝlahan sinatun ulum̃an.
Eus nǝvanuan isob̃ur hǝn lǝb̃egǝm hǝn nǝlahan enan. Ale nǝboŋ nǝhanian toutaut, esǝvat naslev san gail hǝn lǝb̃ekis nǝvanuan galenan gǝmai, be lomǝtahun lǝb̃egǝmai.

Esǝvat naslev galevis am, ike, ‘Kel mai alat notous galit gǝmai ke numaul hǝn nǝhanian tia. Namtotibun nab̃uluk ulum̃an mai natuhb̃uluk tokǝnoh gail, ale natit p̃isi eutaut tia. Mǝtegǝm tutut hǝn nǝhanan nǝlahan!’
Avil alat akiŋ tous galit lǝb̃egǝmai, lǝsasǝsǝloŋ husuri, luvan. Galit sua evi lan nǝtan san, togon evi lan naim p̃urp̃ur san.
Galevis am lutah gat naslev san gail, lomǝdas bun galito vagol lumat.
Akiŋ nǝlon ipaŋpaŋ masuṽ. Esǝvat navǝshǝsoltia san hǝn lǝb̃iṽabun alatenan lotogol nǝmatan ale hǝn lǝb̃epǝŋas nab̃iltivile salito.
Ale ikel mai naslev san gail ke, ‘Nǝhanan hǝn nǝlahan eutaut tia, be alat notous galit hǝn lǝb̃egǝmai lǝsǝbar nǝsa notolǝŋoni tonor len nǝhanan sagw, sanor hǝn lǝb̃egǝmai.
Imaienan, mitivan hǝn nametp̃isal pasil gail, ale nǝvanuan ideh mǝtb̃isab̃i, usi hǝn b̃egǝm vi lan nǝhanan nǝlahan.’
Ale naslev galenan luvan husur nap̃isal gail. Lokis galit p̃isi lotosab̃ gail b̃onb̃on, naut kǝmas lotovoi o lotosa. Ale nǝhanan nǝlahan epul hǝn nǝvanuan.
Be nǝboŋ akiŋ tob̃is lohoim san hǝn b̃eris alat lotohan, eris aulum̃an sual ei sasun nahurabat nǝlahan.
Ale ikel maii ke, ‘Eee Tegai, gaiug gǝsasun nahurabat nǝlahan, gogǝm lohoim gegai mabe?’ Ris naut tob̃ut hǝn atenan.
Beti akiŋ ikel mai nǝvanuan nauman san gail ke, ‘Baŋis gat navǝlan gǝlaru mai narien gǝlaru, bar hǝni vivile len nǝmargobut! Len naut enan dereh litaŋ, lides batriṽoriṽ.’”
AYesu imaris kotov nasoruan san ike, “Husur aGot ekis isob̃ur be ilekis hǝn evis ŋai.”
Ṽur nǝtaks seSisa
Ale naFarisi gail luvan. Nǝboŋ lotovan tonoŋ, Lub̃onb̃on, lusor utaut hǝn lǝb̃igol aYesu b̃ekǝkos len nasoruan san.
Beti losǝvat ahai susur salit gail mai galevis len nǝpati tovi tarhǝt siHerot van hǝn aYesu.
Lousi ke, “Hai p̃usan, namtolǝboii ke gokitin, gop̃usan hǝn nap̃isal siGot len nakitinan. Gukel nakitinan, nǝvanuan b̃etibau o b̃evi naut kǝmas savi natideh len gaiug.
Gikel natsua mai ginamit bai. Inor hǝn datb̃eṽur nǝtaks van hǝn aSisa m̃au a? Gunau mab hǝni?”
Be aYesu elǝboi nagǝrasian tosa salito ale ike, “Vanuan gǝgǝras gail! Imabe mǝtous kitev ginau hum mǝtb̃igol ke nekǝkos?
Ṽusan ginau hǝn natenarius hǝn nǝtaks.” Ale lulav nakoin sua enan van hǝni.
Eus galit ke, “Nǝhon mai nahǝsan ase arupat len nakoin egai?”
Lusor vari ke, “ASisa.” Beti ikel mai galit ke, “Imagenan, lav mai aSisa nǝsa tovi seSisa ale lav mai aGot nǝsa tovi siGot.”
Nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natenan, lup̃aŋ, beti loriŋi, luvan.
Nǝlahan mai na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan
Len nǝboŋ enan ŋai, naSattiusi gail (lotokele ke na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan eb̃uer), logǝm hǝni, lousi
luke, “Hai p̃usan, aMoses ikele ke, ‘Aulum̃an ideh b̃imat anatun b̃eb̃uer, aṽan matmat tilah mai nǝbatunau enan hǝn b̃ipas anatun gail hǝn aṽan tomat b̃ikad anatun gail.’
Ikad alatmiṽan tomǝlevru len ginamito. Ahai a m̃o ilah, ale imat, anatun eb̃uer. Ale aṽan tohusuri ilah mai asoan aten tomat.
Aṽan enan am imat, anatun eb̃uer, ale aṽan tohusuri ilah mai nǝbatunau. Ivan magenan van vǝbar alatmiṽan p̃isi lulah mai alitenan.
Ale nǝboŋ alatmiṽan p̃isi lotomat, alitenan tu imat.
Imagenan, kel mai ginamito, len na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan, alitenan dereh tevi asoan alatmiṽan tomǝlevru ta be, husur ilah mai galit p̃isi?”
AYesu isor var galit ke, “Mǝtusab husur mǝtsalǝboi natosian siGot mai nǝdaŋan san.
Husur len na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan, nǝvanuan gail asike lulah, avan ideh asike idam̃ hǝn lǝb̃ilah, be dereh lesum̃an aŋel gail len nǝmav lǝsǝlah.
Be datb̃isor husur na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan, mǝtsaṽuruŋ nǝsa aGot tokele mai gamito a? Ike,
‘Gagai ginau novi aGot siApraham, aGot seIsak, aGot siJakop.’ Gai savi aGot silat lotomat be silat lotomaur.”
Nǝboŋ naluṽoh gail lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natenan, lumaŋmaŋ len nap̃usanan san.
Nakelean todaŋ totibau, tosǝhor gail p̃isi am
Nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke aYesu togol naSattiusi gail lǝsasor am, naFarisi gail lub̃onb̃on,
ale galit sua tokad namitisau hǝn nalo eus nausian sua hǝni hǝn b̃ekǝkos len na-sor-vari-an san.
Ike, “Hai p̃usan, len nalo gail, ta be esǝhor gail p̃isi am?”
AYesu isor var galit ke, “‘Gelǝmas bun Nasub̃ aGot sam̃ len nǝlom̃ kavkav, nanunum̃ kavkav, mai nǝnauan sam̃ kavkav; len gaiug kavkav.’
Enan evi nakelean todaŋ totibau, tosǝhor gail p̃isi am.
Nakelean todaŋ tohusuri ehum enan, ike ‘Gelǝmas bun nǝvanuan totoh pǝpadaŋ hǝn gaiug sum̃an gotolǝmas bun gaiug gabag.’
Nakelean eru enan artodaŋ arovi nǝbathut nalo kavkav mai nap̃usanan sihai kelkel ur gail p̃isi.”
Anatun ase aKristo, aGot totabtabuh lan?
Beti aYesu eus naFarisi gail lotob̃onb̃on,
ike, “Mǝtb̃inau aKristo, aGot totabtabuh lan, mǝtunau ke gai evi anatun ase, nǝpasusan sise?” Lusor vari ke, “Anatun siTevit.”
Beti aYesu eus galit ke, “B̃imaienan, nǝboŋ aTevit tosor len aNunun aGot, bathut nǝsa ekis aKristo hǝn aMasta? Husur aTevit ike,

content.text: “‘Nasub̃ aGot ikel mai aMasta sagw, ke
vir nǝb̃eriŋ aenemi sam̃ gail pipit nariem̃ gǝlaru

content: “Imaienan, aTevit b̃ekis aKristo hǝn aMasta san, evi anatun mabe?”
Be sǝkad ideh tolǝboi b̃isor var aYesu. Len nǝboŋ enan van, galit p̃isi lomǝtahw hǝn lǝb̃eus nausian ideh hǝni am.

footnotes.text: 22.16 Alat len nǝpati tovi tarhǝt siHerot lovi len nǝpati polotik tolǝŋon ke sua len nǝbathudud siHerot timasvi kiŋ len naut a Jutea, hǝn naut a Jutea b̃ipat akis len navǝlan aRom.
22.42 NaJu gail p̃isi lolǝboii ke dereh aKristo egǝm len nǝpasusan siTevit tovi kiŋ ta sutuai.
